description: TAB character (U+0009) in a string value. RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2 assigns TAB the named two-character escape \t; the canonical form is \t (2 bytes: 5c 74), not the six-byte \u0009. An implementation that outputs \u0009 instead of \t is non-conforming; it produces a different pre-image and therefore a different digest. See jcs-n-tab-long-form-contrast (vector 28) for the both-directions check.
